title: Warning call after a Howard Stern producer's call

tellings.quote: on the other end of the line said, "Drop the story. Don't go on the Sahara Stern and stop talking about it."

plain: A former Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says the NSA, the US spy agency for intercepted communications, hired him to talk with aliens, says that after a producer from the Howard Stern radio show called him, a second call came telling him to drop the story, stay off the Stern show and stop talking about it. Sherman tells it as something that happened to him in his office, which if true would mean someone was watching who he spoke to and wanted him silent.
